scales.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl tracking-tight font-bold text-navy

surfaces.header: sticky top-0 z-50 backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/80 border-b border-border transition-all duration-300
surfaces.cards: bg-white border border-border p-6 md:p-8 rounded-sm hover:-translate-y-1 transition-transform duration-300

hero_background.description: Elegant and smooth dark blue wave pattern for hero section overlay

about_presentation.description: Business people in a modern office meeting, representing professional placement

public_pages.approach: Use pure HTML/Tailwind for layouts. Avoid using Shadcn 'Card' for structural layout sections.
public_pages.hero_section: Use the hero_background image with a dark navy overlay (bg-[#1a2f5a]/80) so white and gold text stands out perfectly. Include primary H1, slogan, and a Gold CTA.
public_pages.job_offers_section: Divide into 3 distinct sections using a CSS Grid or Flex layout. Use the provided sector images. For the 'Postuler' action, use a customized Shadcn Dialog/Drawer with the application form inside.
public_pages.application_form: Use Shadcn Form, Input, Select, and Textarea components. Required fields: Prénom, Nom, Courriel, Téléphone, Secteur visé, Lettre de motivation, CV (File input for PDF). Show a clear success message upon submission using Sonner toast.
public_pages.buttons: Primary buttons: bg-accent text-white hover:bg-accent-hover. Secondary: border-2 border-primary text-primary hover:bg-primary hover:text-white. Always use transitions.

admin_dashboard.approach: Fully utilize Shadcn UI components (Table, Button, Tabs, Dialog, Form, Input).
admin_dashboard.layout: Sidebar navigation (Offres, Candidatures) with a top header. Background should be slightly off-white (bg-slate-50) to contrast with white widgets.
admin_dashboard.auth: Simple password-protected login screen. Use a centered Shadcn Card.
admin_dashboard.job_management: CRUD table for job offers. Must be able to select sector (Entrepôt, Paysagerie, Hôtelier).
admin_dashboard.applications_view: Table listing all candidates with their details. Include a prominent 'Télécharger CV' action for each row.
